This section explains how the automated tests work. For practical steps and input choices, start with Your first check. Unfamiliar terms are explained in the glossary.

.github/workflows/config-job.yml

Bundled source snapshot. Credential-like literals are omitted. Line numbers correspond to the audited repository file; this page is for reading and is not executable test code.

1 name: Config job
2 
3 on:
4     workflow_dispatch:
5 
6 jobs:
7     cache_browsers:
8         runs-on: ubuntu-latest
9 
10         steps:
11             - uses: actions/checkout@v4
12 
13             - name: Set up Node.js
14               uses: actions/setup-node@v6
15               with:
16                   node-version: lts/*
17                   cache: 'npm'
18 
19             - name: Install dependencies
20               run: npm ci
21 
22             - name: Cache Playwright browsers
23               uses: actions/cache@v4
24               id: playwright-cache
25               with:
26                   path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
27                   key: playwright-browsers-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
28 
29             - name: Install Playwright browsers
30               if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
31               run: npx playwright install --with-deps
32 
33             - name: Install Playwright system deps
34               if: steps.playwright-cache.outputs.cache-hit == 'true'
35               run: npx playwright install-deps
36
